title: Backup power and emergency egress lighting need test records
remediation: The sponsor continuity and facilities leads approve the required orderly shutdown or long-term power transfer mode. Collect an authorized power-loss test showing UPS behavior and maintenance records for automatic emergency lighting along exits and evacuation routes. Validate site and provider coverage before accepting inheritance.

milestones.title: Collect an approved power continuity mode, UPS test and automatic emergency lighting inspection with evacuation route coverage
